brief.headline: Blackstone targets $3bn for real estate secondaries fund
bullets: Real Estate: Blackstone is seeking to raise at least $3bn for a new real estate secondaries fund, targeting discounted stakes in existing property vehicles as liquidity pressures continue across the sector, according to Bloomberg.

M&A & Buyouts: EasyJet shareholders have approved the airline’s £5.7bn takeover by Apollo Global Management, clearing a major hurdle in one of the largest private equity buyouts of a European airline, according to Reuters.
Family Offices & Wealth: The Dubai office will serve as a hub for Blackstone’s Private Wealth business in the region.

M&A & Buyouts: A joint venture led by CP Group has secured $271.5 million in financing from a Blackstone affiliate for the acquisition and planned renovation of the 30-acre Mizner Park complex in Downtown Boca Raton, Fla., property records show.
M&A & Buyouts: Funds managed by Blackstone Private Equity will invest Rs 5,000 crore, about $535 million, in Indian non-bank lender IIFL Finance.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The S&P 500 stands at 7,619.38 (up 1.3% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 17.5, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.88% (up 2 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.25 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.30%, near long-run norms (down 4 bps on the prior reading).
